prompt:
Design ONE new BACK COVER for The Vegetable Guru, portrait 185:240, flat artwork, no mockup. Reference 1 is the selected FRONT: match its sunny yellow ground, deep forest-green ink, rounded green outer frame, thin grid rules and friendly Lilita One letterforms. Reference 2 is the OLD BACK: preserve its title, guide-count headline, all three prose paragraphs, price and barcode placeholder EXACTLY, but replace its torn page collage and redesign the composition. References 3 and 4 are approved vegetable illustration STYLE references: broad saturated colour planes, simplified silhouettes, graphic highlight strokes, confident foliage, no fine naturalistic rendering. New back should feel like a considered companion to front, calmer with much more comfortable space for reading. ONE type family throughout, Lilita One-style, with smaller comfortably spaced text for prose. Proposed composition: modest two-line title at top, strong guide-count statement below, a thin horizontal green rule, three LEFT-ALIGNED prose paragraphs in a generous wide single column, then a shallow three-cell strip of small vegetable illustrations (carrots, tomatoes, French beans) separated by the same green grid rules as front. Price lower left and a plain white reserved barcode rectangle lower right, within the outer frame. Prioritise all prose readable with generous margins and line spacing; illustrations are secondary and can be modest. No fake sample-page text, no extra slogans, no author bio, no YouTube badge on this back. No new copy whatsoever. Exact text to include ONCE each:
Title: The Vegetable Guru
Headline: 44 growing guides and 14 troubleshooting guides
Paragraph 1: Growing vegetables raises plenty of questions: when to sow, how much space to leave, when to harvest, and what to do when something starts eating the crop before you do.
Paragraph 2: These illustrated guides bring the useful details together, with clear calendars, planting advice and organic ways to tackle common troubles.
Paragraph 3: There’s practical help with soil, compost, watering and greenhouses too. Use it to plan your plot, then turn to the guide you need as each job comes along.
Price: £17.50
Inside plain white barcode box: ISBN / BARCODE
Keep exact punctuation and wording, no omissions. The barcode is a placeholder box, do NOT invent a real barcode or ISBN. Yellow colour and frame weight must connect directly to reference 1. Produce a polished complete back-cover concept.
changes: Yellow field and green rounded frame/rules match front. Three-crop strip replaces torn-page collage and its sample text. Main title, guide counts, all three blurb paragraphs, working price and barcode placeholder retained.
